column1: # Curated leaf dissection scores for the sequenced species (mature foliage leaves of wild-type plants).
# dissection_order = number of nested levels of division of the leaf blade:
#   0 simple (entire, toothed or shallowly lobed); 1 once divided (deeply lobed, or once compound: pinnate/palmate/trifoliolate);
#   2 twice divided (e.g. compound with lobed leaflets, bipinnatifid); 3 three or more levels (e.g. 2-3-pinnate, finely dissected).
# include = 0 for taxa where "leaf" is absent or not comparable (algae, bryophytes, leafless parasites/cacti, fronds, cladodes, Utricularia).
# Scores were assigned from standard botanical descriptions by the analyst (Claude), NOT from a database; confidence flags where unsure.
# They are to be cross-checked against image-based fractal dimension (scripts/05_*) and corrected where wrong.
